title: feat(spec)!: a page declares nothing the console does not honour — isDefault only on a bound record page, a closed template set, regions its template places
body:
Part of #23610
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Executes ruling `6190536588` items 1, 2 and 3 (Q1 A · Q2 A, plus half 1) under claim `6194235384`. Item 4 (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`) is a separate Tier H PR (claim `6204703954`). That PR carries the card's closing keyword, so this one is `Part of` and the card closes with its last piece; item 5's follow-ups (the objectui card, the hotcrm memo) belong to the director seat. One PR, not split: +1055/−100 across 33 files after patch round 2 (pin bump included), generated artifacts included, about two of precedent #23331's size for two refusals, as the ruling's workload line estimated.

## What changes

**Q1 — `isDefault: true` off a record page bound to an object is refused at every door.** One sentence, `misplacedDefaultPageRefusal` (`packages/spec/src/ui/default-record-page.ts`, next to `defaultRecordPageObject`, whose reading it reuses — no second judge). It names where a landing is really set: the app's first navigation item, and the app's own `isDefault` for the root landing. A record page with no `object` gets the bind-the-object variant.

**Q2 — `template` closes and each template declares its slots.** `PageTemplateSchema` = `default`, `header-sidebar-main`, `three-column`, `dashboard`; `full-width` is retired by name through `enumWithRetiredValues` (prescription: use `default`, renders the same). `PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS` declares the slots per the ruling; `PAGE_TEMPLATE_OPEN_GRID` = `dashboard`. `checkPageRegionPlacement` refuses, at `regions.N.name`, a region the template does not place, naming the template's slots and a rename hint (`left_sidebar` to `sidebar`, `right_sidebar` to `aside`, `content` to `main`). Judged on `kind: 'full'` pages only (a `slotted` page renders its `slots`, `html` / `react` their `source`) and case-insensitively, as the renderer's `findRegion` is. A second region that fills a slot an earlier region already fills is refused the same way, naming the region that fills it, because `findRegion` places the first match only. This came in the seat's patch round (record `6199121442` item 2). On `dashboard`, a second `header` or `footer` is refused; two regions of any other name stay two grid cells.

**Half 1 — the text says what runs.** `PageTypeSchema`'s docblock and enum comments: `home`, `app` and `utility` are one region layout at three content widths; `home` is not a landing declaration; `utility` is an ordinary inline page with no floating or docked shell slot, and stays a type because the print door and the page-type width read it. The `print`-on-`utility` refusal no longer says "floating panel" (its pin in `page-print.test.ts` now also asserts the word is gone). `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` (page types, a Templates table, the `isDefault` row, the region snippet's `content` to `main`), and the liveness `type`, `template`, `regions`, `isDefault` rows (re-read at objectui `0656b0e3c0`).

## Door by door (PM mechanism assumption 1, measured)

| Door | Goes through `PageSchema`? | What this PR does there | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `definePage` / `defineStack` (`stack.zod.ts`, `pages: z.array(PageSchema)`), so `os validate` / `os build` | yes | nothing — the two new `superRefine`s refuse | `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` 422 at `pages.N.isDefault` / `pages.N.template` / `pages.N.regions.M.name` (`page-default-and-region-placement.test.ts`, `stack-default-record-page.test.ts`) |
| metadata save door (`saveMetaItem`, `getMetadataTypeSchema('page')`) | yes | nothing | `422 INVALID_METADATA`, nothing stored, both topologies (`default-record-page-save-door.test.ts`) |
| package registration, package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`) | **no** — the registry parses only object / app / package / plugin bodies | `refuseDefaultRecordPageConflicts` first refuses misplaced defaults (`misplacedDefaultPages`, same sources as `declaredDefaultRecordPages`, nested `plugins[]` included), ahead of every mutation | `MisplacedDefaultPageError`, `INVALID_METADATA` 422 (existing code, no new one), no package record left (`registry-default-record-page.test.ts`) |
| package registration, item seam (`registerItem` with a `packageId`) | **no** | refuses before the holder check | same envelope |
| bare slot (`registerItem` with no package: `sys_metadata` hydration) | — | not judged, by the door's existing design | pinned as a control |
| `core` `stack-organization-record-page.ts` | n/a — a reader of `defaultRecordPageObject`, not a door | unchanged | `core` suite green |

Q2's refusals are parse-only (the ruling names `os validate` and save), so the registry carries no template or region judgement.

## Stored metadata (assumption 4, measured)

No D2 conversion touches these shapes and the read path does not refuse them: a `sys_metadata` page row laid in the store with a non-record `isDefault: true`, `template: 'full-width'` or a `left_sidebar` region is served by `getMetaItem` unchanged, on both the environment-scoped and the host-config kernel; saving it again answers 422. `applyConversionsToStoredItem` returns each row byte-equal with zero notices, and the parse still refuses it. The changeset's "Stored metadata keeps loading" paragraph states exactly this.

## First-party writers (assumption 5)

- `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/capability-map.page.ts` drops `isDefault: true`; it stays the landing as the first `ShowcaseApp.navigation` item.
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`: three `os:check-yaml` pages named `template: standard` / `console` (with `left` / `right` regions), red under `check:yaml-examples` — now `default` and `header-sidebar-main` with `sidebar` / `main`; the callouts that called `template` a free-form string are corrected.
- `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/task-visualizations.pages.ts`: its shared base held `template: 'default'` as a widened `string` and stopped type-checking against the closed set (+7 root-program errors under `check:type-check-debt`); now `as const`. The changeset carries the same one-line migration for consumers.
- No first-party page wrote `full-width` or an unplaced region in source. Census: `full-width` in two test fixtures only; every `regions` entry in `examples/**`, `packages/**`, `content/docs/**` read by name (main 226, header 40, sidebar 9, footer 4, aside 1, the rest test-only).

Fixture triage (rule's consumption radius, not the edited package):

- **Replaced** (pinned exactly the removed branch): `stack-default-record-page.test.ts` "an isDefault page that is not a record page is outside the rule", `registry-default-record-page.test.ts` same, `default-record-page-save-door.test.ts` same — each now asserts the refusal, with a no-flag control beside it. `page.test.ts` "should accept page with custom template" (`three-column-layout`) and "should accept default page" (no `object`).
- **Respelled**: the two `buildDefaultPageSchema` seed fixtures (`spec` and `lint` `*-22537.test.ts`) from `full-width` to `default`, with a note.
- **Re-anchored**: `expression-scope-app-root.pin.test.ts`'s LIT control quoted the old page-type sentence.
- **Extended**: `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` catalogues the two new checks (bijection, attached-by-identifier, barrel identity).

## Renderer premise (assumption 3, re-read)

objectui `main` at `0656b0e3c0` (and the sparse read at `2bacbf08b4`): `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY` still holds `default`, `full-width`, `header-sidebar-main`, `three-column`, `dashboard`; `default` and `full-width` are the same `FullWidthTemplate`, so **no rendering fork** and nothing was posted on the card for it. Slots match the ruling's table; `findRegion` is case-insensitive, which this PR follows.

**One premise did not hold — "zero first-party writers" of `full-width`.** objectui's `packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` returns `template: 'full-width'`, and Studio's record-page create seed (`app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts`, `createSeed`) copies it into the page it saves. Retirement proceeds as ruled (identical rendering, no alias window), but that seed must say `default` before or with the pin bump that ships this, or a Studio "new record page" save answers 422. objectui's `PageNodeSchema` also redeclared `template` as `string` over the spec member, which is TS2430 against this spec (measured on a mirror, report `6200739195`). Both are fixed in objectstack-ai/objectui#12585, the sibling fix that AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist step 4) ships with this PR.

## Ledger

Two D3 entries, `page-is-default-off-record-page-refused` and `page-template-closed-region-unplaced-refused`; no D2 conversion (ruling: no grace or alias window); no tombstone (no key removed). No `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment was added: neither precedent entry for `isDefault` carried one, and draft PR #23418 is editing `registry.ts.template`. BREAKING changeset `.changeset/23610-page-isdefault-template-slots.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/objectql` patch, ADR-0087 marker `registered` naming both ids. New exports regenerate `api-surface/`, `export-origins/`, `declaration-map/` and `content/docs/references/`. The template block sits after `PageComponentSchema` on purpose, so `skills/objectstack-ui/references/_index.md` (first five exports of the file) stays byte-identical and no `skills/**` path enters this PR.

## Verification (final head `4815bfa99`, after merging `origin/main` `f77ba411e`)

- `@objectstack/spec`: 742 files / 21,868 tests passed. `check:generated`: all 14 artifacts current.
- Downstream consumers of the narrowed schema, all green: `objectql` 8,157, `metadata-protocol` 20,560 (19 skipped), `core` 2,586, `lint` 6,771, `metadata-core` 728, `platform-objects` 1,091, `plugin-approvals` 1,080, `cloud-connection` 555, `mcp` 467, `downstream-contract` 31, `example-showcase` 411, `example-crm` 46, `cli` unit 4,354 (integration layer declared to CI). `objectql`, `metadata-protocol`, `example-showcase` re-run on the final head after the merge.
- `typecheck` green for spec, objectql, metadata-protocol, core, lint, cli, platform-objects, plugin-approvals, cloud-connection, mcp, downstream-contract, example-showcase, example-crm; root program back to its ledger's 26.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 119 families) on the final head: all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation "119 derived, 119 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". Two families first refused on the shallow clone (`check-engine-split-ratio`, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`) and passed after the deepening they prescribe. Local-only: `check:dev-prereqs` 0, `check:skill-frame-freshness` 0.
- Ablations (each through `ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, restore proven by an empty `git diff HEAD`): drop `checkPageDefaultPlacement` 8 red; drop `checkPageRegionPlacement` 4 red; `template` back to `z.string()` 5 red; drop the package-door throw 1 red (the item seam still catches the top-level pages; the nested-plugin and no-record pin goes red); drop the item-seam throw 1 red.
- Reverse type verification: `template: 'full-width'` in a showcase page gives `TS2322 … not assignable to type '"dashboard" | "default" | "header-sidebar-main" | "three-column"'`, so the rebuilt `.d.ts` was read.

## Landing order

1. Done: objectstack-ai/objectui#12585 merged on objectui `main` as `daeb77fc84dd`. The Studio record-page seed says `default`, and `PageNodeSchema.template` takes the spec's type in both the TS and zod faces.
2. Done (patch round 2, head `d36a804054`):
   - The branch merged `main` at `140238a47b`, after #23738 had moved the pin to `f96f771140f1`.
   - `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` moved `.objectui-sha` forward to `daeb77fc84dd`, which carries #12585, and wrote `.changeset/console-daeb77fc84dd.md` (`@objectstack/console`: minor).
   - `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` and `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` are re-recorded at the new pin. `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-unchanged, and the lockstep needs no port.
3. Done: the new head has its delta contract-review record, PASS `6206263948` (the full PASS `6204434889` on `c2b9935b4` stands for everything it judged). The seat then marks this PR ready.
4. After this PR merges, the Tier H PR #23758 (ruling item 4, `Fixes #23610`) is marked ready, and #23776 (#23710) merges `main` and lands after it (landing-operations D).

## Patch round (head `c2b9935b4`, `origin/main` `8c85141c5` merged)

- `@objectstack/spec`: 742 files / 21,876 tests passed. The downstream consumer set is unchanged and green. The duplicate-slot ablation (the branch never fires) gives 6 red of 285; restored.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 119 families, 119 exit 0 (two `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` exits on a fresh worktree passed after the full build). `check:generated` 14/14. CI on `c2b9935b4`: 41 check-runs, 36 success, 5 skipped.

## Acceptance notes

- Two regions filling the same slot (two `main`) were accepted and the second was dropped by the renderer. They are now refused in this PR (patch round, `c2b9935b4`).
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` rows for the Tier H follow-up are listed in the dispatch report on #23610.
